description: Send a reply, a reply draft or a forward without Thunderbird's composer window, in the thread (References, In-Reply-To), marking the original as answered.

functions.name: send
functions.description: Send now. details: { to, cc, bcc ("Name <address>" strings), subject, body (HTML, quote included), isPlainText, identityId, attachments: [{ file, name }] }. options: { kind: reply | forward | draft, relatedId (the email answered, or the draft) }. Returns { headerMessageId }.
